Package arcade.core.vis

Class Panel

java.lang.Object
arcade.core.vis.Panel
public class Panel extends Object
Wrapper for JFrame windows containing visualizations.

Each JFrame object is generated by a Display object from the MASON library. Each Panel is a window that can contain one or more drawings made by Drawer objects. All Panel objects are created by Visualization and then attaches Drawer objects to their assigned Panel.
